name: CFI Sacramento
summary: Sacramento flight school with a fleet table of eleven aircraft and tiered instructor rates.
differentiator: Its own $10,900 private pilot example prices a Cessna 172 at $200 an hour, while its fleet table lists Cessna 172s at $220 to $250, so the example runs $20 to $50 an hour under the table.
pricing: Cessna 172N at $220 to $230 an hour with fuel, instruction $55 to $75 an hour.

estimate.hoursBasis: 40 flight hours in a Cessna 172 at $200 an hour, plus 20 hours of ground and 30 hours of flight instruction at $55 and about $150 of materials
estimate.note: Its example uses $200 an hour; its fleet table lists Cessna 172s at $220 to $250.

feesNamed: Minimum one hour of flight time per reservation
bestFor: Students who want pay-as-you-go training with fuel included and no club fees.
skipIf: You want the example total to match the fleet rates.
watchOut: The $10,900 example uses $200 an hour for a Cessna 172; the fleet table lists $220 to $250.
Instruction rates vary by instructor and level ($55 to $75).
